svg.title: DIA-001 · The still
svg.desc: An engraved plate of a distilling apparatus. Loose letters fall into a funnel on a large retort that sits in a brick furnace with a fire drawn in rust. Vapour passes down a beak into a coiled worm inside a tub, and drips into a small receiving flask. A thin pipe returns from the receiver over the top of the apparatus back into the retort. A tap on the receiver fills a small glass.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 1 · WHAT'S BEING BUILT
a. The charge: trillions of words. b. The fire: specialized chips, weeks, $100M to $1B a run. c. The worm: billions of tiny adjustments.
d. The receiver: one file, about 100 billion numbers. e. The return: each model helps make the next. f. The tap: your prompt.
DIA-001 · The model is what collects in the flask. What it costs is the fire.
